minor.issue: Was returning 500 due to ObjectId in response (motor mutates dict adding _id); FIXED in this iteration by adding _id to excluded keys in user_out projection.

issues: Sessions section header label not literally 'Sessions' in DOM text (Revoke button present, but heading uses different copy). Consider an explicit 'Active sessions' heading for clarity and a11y/testability.

Optional: add data-testid to setup-mfa inputs (manual-key, 6-digit code, enable button) to make automated testing robust against secret-detection regex.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1298 lines — well past the 700 threshold. Strongly recommend splitting into routers/{auth,mfa,sessions,activity,admin,jobs,companies,files,public,payments,invoice}.py. With Phase 2B added, the file is becoming hard to navigate.

auth/register response originally leaked Mongo ObjectId via inserted dict (fixed). Apply same pattern audit to ALL handlers that read-then-return a doc that was just inserted (motor mutates the dict). For example double-check /api/team POST, /api/customers POST, /api/jobs POST — each should explicitly drop _id before returning.

/api/users/invite returns temp_password in plaintext in the JSON response. While useful for owner-driven flow when email isn't verified, this is a potential leak if logs/screenshots are shared. Consider gating it behind an explicit ?show_temp=1 flag or only returning when env=DEV.

/api/auth/forgot returns reset_url in production response — fine for the documented owner-driven flow, but ensure this is documented as intentional and consider stripping in production via env flag (e.g. only when EMAIL_DELIVERY_OK=false).
/api/auth/reset enforces only `len < 6` password rule. Add minimum strength check (uppercase + digit, length>=8) consistent with seeded super admin password policy.
/api/sessions returns user.get('_session_id') marker that is set in get_current_user — verify token rotation sets fresh session ids on every login (already does via create_session). Good.

/api/users PATCH allows changing role to any value in ROLES — owner could escalate a user to 'super_admin' since the role is in ROLES. Add explicit guard: actor.role != 'super_admin' must not allow setting target role to 'super_admin'.

Resend free tier silently fails to send to non-verified domains. Endpoint returns email_sent=false correctly, but consider surfacing this in the Activity log entry payload for invite events so admins know whether email was actually delivered.

rca of the issue: Single defect found: POST /api/auth/register returned HTTP 500 because motor's insert_one mutates the input dict adding ObjectId at key '_id'. The handler then built user_out by filtering only password_hash + mfa_secret, leaving _id in place. FastAPI's jsonable_encoder cannot serialize ObjectId — raised TypeError → 500. Fix: include '_id' in the excluded keys set when constructing user_out (1-line change at server.py line 393). Verified by re-running test_phase2b::test_cross_tenant_edit_blocked which exercises the register endpoint — now returns 200 with valid JSON. Recommendation: add a generic helper `clean_user(doc)` to centralise this projection across the file.
